text:
Still
+
+not upon the branch
+
+in the air
+
+Not in the air
+
+in the instant
+
+the hummingbird

translation.title: The Exclamation
translation.editorial_note: Quieto remains the paradoxical stillness of a hovering bird; punctuation is not added, allowing the hummingbird itself to arrive as the final exclamation.
